item.title: Death toll rises to six in Lagos GNI fire
item.description: Lagos State Government has confirmed that the death toll from the inferno at the 25-storey Great Nigeria Insurance, GNI, House on Lagos Island has increased to six. The latest update followed the recovery of another body from the debris on the eighth day of sustained search and rescue operations at the site. In a statement […] Death toll rises to six in Lagos GNI fire

item.title: 2027: Key political players will move to ADC first quarter of 2026 – Ahmed
item.description: The National Treasurer of the African Democratic Congress, ADC, Mani Ahmed, has expressed optimism that key political players will move into the party in the first quarter of 2026. Ahmed said this on Wednesday while responding to questions in an interview on Arise Television monitored by DAILY POST. item.title: Education Minister, Alausa reveals reasons for schoolchildren abductions
item.description: Minister of Education, Tunji Alausa, has said that there were political undertone to the abductions of schoolchildren in the past few weeks. Alausa stated this on Wednesday on ‘2025 in Retrospect: Charting a Pathway into 2026’ a programme on Channels Television monitored by DAILY POST. item.title: AFCON: Lookman speaks on team he wants Nigeria to avoid in knockout stage
item.description: Super Eagles forward, Ademola Lookman has insisted that there is no particular team he wants Nigeria to avoid in the knockout stage of the 2025 Africa Cup of Nations. Lookman addressed reporters following Nigeria’s 3-1 victory over Uganda in the final group stage encounter on Tuesday. The Atalanta player expressed his respect for all teams, […] AFCON: Lookman speaks on team he wants Nigeria to avoid in knockout stage

item.title: New Year: Join ADC to better Nigeria – Mark urges citezens
item.description: The National Chairman of the African Democratic Congress (ADC), Sen. David Mark, has called on Nigerians to join the party’s mission to better Nigeria. This is contained in a statement issued by his Special Adviser on Media, Paul Mumeh in Kano on Thursday. In his New Year message, Mark acknowledged the hardships faced by Nigerians […] New Year: Join ADC to better Nigeria – Mark urges citezens

item.title: All 8 countries eliminated ahead of Round of 16 fixtures
item.description: Eight countries have been eliminated from the 2025 Africa Cup of Nations, AFCON, tournament in Morocco ahead of the Round of 16 stage. They are: Gabon, Equatorial Guinea, Botswana, Uganda, Zimbabwe, Angola, Zambia and Comoros. This comes after the conclusion of the AFCON final Group stage fixtures played on Wednesday night. item.title: Banditry, porous borders fuel insecurity in Kano – KCJF
item.description: Stakeholders at a high-level roundtable organised by the Kano Concerned Journalists’ Forum (KCJF) have warned that insecurity in Kano State is escalating due to banditry, cross-border criminality and socio-economic pressures, calling for urgent and coordinated action by government and security agencies. item.title: Nasarawa senator, Akwashiki dies at 52
item.description: The Senator representing Nasarawa North, Godiya Akwashiki, has died at the age of 52, following a protracted illness. A family source, who confirmed the incident to the News Agency of Nigeria on condition of anonymity on Thursday in Nassarawa Eggon, said that Akwashiki died in an Indian hospital on Wednesday, December 31, 2025.
